title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement_md: Given a string `s`, return the longest palindromic substring in `s`.

hints.text: A palindrome mirrors around its center.
There are 2n - 1 potential centers (n single characters and n-1 between characters).
Expand outwards from each center while s[left] == s[right] and track maximum length.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Expand Around Centers
Treat each position and gap as a potential palindrome center, expanding outward in $O(n)$ per center.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(n^2)$
- **Space Complexity:** $O(1)$
